messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout: service `inference-api` -> v2.4.0-beta at 10% (us-west & us-east). Changelog: tokenizer perf + KV prefetch. Auto-rollback: p95 > 380ms or 5xx > 1% over 5m. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-04/v2.4.0
oliver: rolling. running canary suite and smoke probes.
maya: excluding enterprise tenants and embeddings-heavy orgs. quiet window at 02:00 UTC.
trent: 4m in: us-west p95 210ms, us-east p95 360ms (tail). 5xx ~0.3% mostly timeouts from tokenizer.
infra: seeing increased GC pauses on a subset of us-east tokenizer pods, looks related to the new prefetch memory pattern. not all nodes affected.
maya: HOLD further ramp until infra confirms memory behavior. prefer isolate region if possible.
ops-bot: suggestion: pin us-east back to v2.3.9 while leaving us-west on canary. Command: `pin-version --service inference-api --region us-east --version v2.3.9`
oliver: +1 to isolate. i'll keep us-west at 10% and extend canary run to 20m.
infra: applied temporary pin on us-east and restarted affected tokenizer pods; memory pressure dropped.
deploy-bot: Pin executed: us-east -> v2.3.9. us-west remains at 10% for v2.4.0-beta. Audit: https://deploys/release/1719001234/pin
maya: logging note: "Partial pin us-east due to tokenizer prefetch GC tail; continue us-west canary. Revisit with memory fix in v2.4.1."
oliver: will monitor metrics and reconvene in 20m. thanks all :coffee:
